name: Pull Request Video Explainer
summary: Turn a GitHub pull request into a code-change explainer using its diff, commits and source files.
problem: A pull request is difficult to communicate to a broad audience when its code changes are presented without a concise visual narrative.
coreOutcomes: Inspect the pull request as the source of the change story
Plan a changelog, feature reveal, fix or refactor explainer
Build and validate a rendered HyperFrames composition
requirements: A GitHub pull request or repository reference
GitHub CLI access to the requested change
boundaries: The source is a code change, not a website capture or general topic
Do not claim tests, review, merge or deployment states not supported by the pull request evidence
